display_name: GPO Deployment with Pilot OU Rollout
description: Creates and links a Group Policy Object (GPO) with a staged rollout: pilot OU first, then domain-wide. Validates policy application before broadening scope. Rollback removes GPO links and deletes the GPO.

gpo_name.label: GPO Name
gpo_name.description: Name of the Group Policy Object to create

gpo_settings_json.label: GPO Settings (JSON)
gpo_settings_json.description: JSON blob describing registry/security/script settings to apply

pilot_ou.label: Pilot OU DN
pilot_ou.description: Distinguished name of the pilot OU for initial rollout (e.g. OU=Pilot,DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com)

target_ous.label: Target OUs
target_ous.description: List of OU DNs to link GPO after pilot validation (empty = domain root only)

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run preflight only — no GPO created

rollback.description: Remove all GPO links and delete the GPO using Remove-GPLink and Remove-GPO.

steps.description: Verify GPO name is unique and pilot OU exists
Link GPO to pilot OU and wait for policy application
Validate GPO applied correctly on pilot OU machines
Link GPO to production OUs after pilot validation
